name: AIPT SharePoint Intake
description: Reference mapping for the AIPT SharePoint intake list. Column names come from the harmonized AIPT intake dataset (merged_list.csv and the live SharePoint list). Consumed by scidk/pipeline/ — the plugin never reads it.

conventions.key_property: A string names the merge key. A list is a preference order: the first property with a non-empty value becomes the merge key (so a Person keys on email when known and falls back to display name).
conventions.properties: Column-per-property form. Each entry names a target property and the source column, with an optional transform.
conventions.source_and_property_map: Transform-per-node form, used when one column expands into several properties. The transform returns a dict (or a list of dicts when cardinality is many) and property_map renames its keys onto node properties.
conventions.cardinality: 'one' emits at most one node per row; 'many' emits one node per element the transform returns.
conventions.transform_args: Extra keyword arguments passed to the transform. sp_colresolution also receives the whole row.
conventions.fallback: Consulted only when the primary column or transform yields nothing. 'template' interpolates row columns plus __row_index__.
conventions.omit_empty_properties: Properties resolving to empty/None are left off the node rather than written blank.
conventions.identifier_safety: Labels, relationship types, and property names are interpolated raw into Cypher by write_declared_nodes. The Pipeline mapping engine must sanitize every identifier in this file before writing.

source.notes: The plugin already collapses internal whitespace in headers, so 'PI  Archived' matches 'PI Archived'. Attachment columns are written back by the Power Automate mirror flow.

row_filter.error_message: row has neither CACProtocol nor ShortDescription

fallback.notes: Deterministic so re-running the same export converges on the same node.

node_mappings.label: Person
node_mappings.notes: SharePoint-native rows carry a People-picker display name in User_sp with no address; legacy Drupal rows carry plain text in UserName_orig / UserEmail_orig.

source.notes: The archived plain-text column holds 'Jane Smith <j@mit.edu>'. PI_display is the raw People-picker name, which yields no address.

node_mappings.label: Attachment
node_mappings.notes: Only a mirrored attachment is materialized. status 'not_copied' means the Power Automate flow saw the file but did not copy it, so there is nothing to point at.

vocabulary_check.notes: A soft consistency check: values outside the list are reported and never block a run. The authoritative vocabulary is expected to live in a SharePoint list pulled via rclone; default_vocabulary is the fallback when none is configured.
vocabulary_check.source_format: One column per field, column header is the field name, column values are the allowed terms.
